case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-J1.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
sup:DEMO-J1.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your clear and practical offer for the SH-220 stainless shaft. We appreciate that everything is already set up on your side.

To be transparent with you, we have a competing offer on the table:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

We would like to give you a fair chance to win this part, so we have prepared three options for you:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option C keeps your usual payment terms unchanged. The other options trade a longer payment term against price, so you can choose what suits your shop best.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your quick and complete offer for the SH-220 shaft, and for your clear interest in working with us. We appreciate it.

To make a decision on this award, we need terms closer to our requirements. All options include delivery to our site rather than ex works. One option leaves your payment term unchanged, and another trades a longer term for a slightly different price, so you can choose what suits your business best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

We would welcome your confirmation of the option that works best for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thanks for being open about the other offer. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our offer is a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. As a small shop we really need to stick to 30 days to keep the cash flowing, so I can't do the longer payment terms. But I want this job, so I'll include DAP delivery and drop the price to €15.70 to beat your other guy. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our Lieferzeit is 28 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer, for checking the competing quote so carefully, and for including DAP delivery. We appreciate your clear wish to win this part.

We understand that steady cash flow matters to a small shop. Option A therefore offers faster payment, reflected in the price as you suggested. Option C keeps your standard payment terms. All three options include DAP.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.76; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 15.20; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.10; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

As you are clarifying internally, we hope these options are easy to take to your discussion. We look forward to your choice.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

We appreciate your transparency regarding the alternative offer and your flexibility in proposing 14-day payment terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our offer stands at a price of €16.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

As faster payment supports our operations, we are pleased to accept the 14-day payment term and reduce our price to €16.50 per unit, offering an alternative package at a price of €16.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

This proposal reflects our commitment to building a long-term partnership while maintaining our high standards of quality and reliable DAP delivery. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
